accueillez_les_paroles_importantes_avec_: Receive important words with attention before seeking to respond or explain.
exprimez_vos_attentes_simplement_afin_de: Express your expectations simply to limit misunderstandings and unnecessary interpretations.
gardez_de_l_espace_pour_vous_lorsque_les: Keep space for yourself when exchanges become too demanding or distracting.
restez_disponible_aux_echanges_sans_vous: Stay available for exchanges without forcing yourself. A sincere presence is worth more than constant availability.
preservez_vos_limites_et_observez_si_les: Preserve your boundaries and observe if efforts, listening, and attention truly circulate in both directions.
cette_section_presente_une_lecture_astro: This section presents an astrological reading of your relationships and never replaces your judgment or free will.
